newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine near cash soybeans slip in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine near cash soybeans slip in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine nearby cash soybeans slipped at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, dragged down by a lower Chigago and a shortage of buyers, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans lost $2 in Rosario to $278. But volume was very low. Demand was also muted for cash maize and sunflower seed. FAS elevator sunflower seed lost $6 to $220 in Rosario in cash trade. Maize prices were mainly steady, with there was little export demand.
